name: Chalk-Hound

Traits.name: Chalk Seam
Traits.text: When the chalk-hound moves through a wall or object, the chalk-hound leaves a pale, crumbling seam in the surface. A creature that spends an action studying the seam can follow the chalk-hound's path through the intervening spaces, and the seam betrays where the chalk-hound will emerge.
Traits.clause: The chalk-hound leaves a pale, crumbling seam in any surface it passes through. A creature that watches a seam can track
Traits.expressedQuote: the chalk-hound leaves a pale, crumbling seam in the surface

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The chalk-hound can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the chalk-hound has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The chalk-hound makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Pull Through.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Pull Through
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 16, one Medium or smaller creature the chalk-hound is touching. *Failure:* 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the chalk-hound drags the target up to 15 feet through a wall, floor, or other solid object it can pass through; the target emerges Prone in the nearest unoccupied space at the far side. If no such space is within 15 feet, the target is not moved. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.gmQuote: walks through walls and drags you back out through them

lore: A chalk-hound is the residue of children who died lost and pressed into old flint-and-chalk brickwork, and it hunts the living to pull one more warm body into the wall to keep them company in the dark.
